correctness.rationale: For H={3,4}, nonnegativity at t=1/2 and 5/14 yields the positive dual certificate sT(1/2)+T(5/14)=1+s-lambda(r+s)>=0, where r=cos(2pi/7), s=cos(pi/7); ratio (1+s)/(r+s)=2r. For lambda=2r, b=(3-10r)/7,c=4(r-1)/7 the Chebyshev quartic factors 32(1-r)(x+1)(x+r)^2(q-x)/7, q=(5+2r-4r^2)/4>1. Equality at x=-1,-r plus interior stationarity determines unique coefficients (determinant 7(2r²-r-1) nonzero). Independently verified factor coefficient-by-coefficient in Q[r]/(8r³+4r²-4r-1) using Sympy polynomial remainders; numerically q≈1.173>1. Global nonnegativity, not finite grid testing.
residual_risks: Applies precisely to real even coefficients and H={3,4}; not arbitrary two-element supports.
